corrections.evidence: Honda Euro-spec press text: wheelbase reduced from 2630 to 2620 mm vs predecessor; CarExpert also 2620. (ADAC 3rd-gen facelift pages show 2630, so this remains a conflict; manufacturer press figure preferred.)
Honda Euro-spec press text: relocated spare wheel made the new CR-V about 105 mm shorter than its predecessor (4635), at 4530 mm. autokosten lists 4525 - minor.
ADAC CR-V 2.2 i-DTEC Comfort AWD (11/12-02/15): Länge 4570, Breite 1820, Höhe 1685 mm, 589/1146/1669 l.
On the 2015 facelift: 'Front-wheel drive versions make do with the existing 120 PS/300 Nm 1.6 i-DTEC engine' (i.e. pre-facelift 1.6 i-DTEC = 120 PS).
ADAC CR-V 2.0 Elegance 2WD (03/15-08/18): Länge 4605, Breite 1820, Höhe 1685, Radstand 2630, 589/1146/1669 l.
Facelift retained 'the 153bhp i-VTEC petrol unit with two and four-wheel drive' (153 bhp = 155 PS).
'Front-wheel drive versions make do with the existing 120 PS/300 Nm 1.6 i-DTEC engine and six-speed manual transmission.'
Uprated 1.6 i-DTEC with 160 PS / 350 Nm, only for 4WD variants (6-speed manual or 9-speed automatic); whatcar: 158 bhp.
European CR-V e:HEV and e:PHEV both 184 PS; ADAC lists e:PHEV 135 kW (184 PS).
ADAC CR-V 2.0 i-MMD e:PHEV Elegance Tech 2WD: Systemleistung 135 kW (184 PS), 335 Nm.
ADAC HR-V 1.6 i-DTEC Comfort (09/15-08/18): 88 kW (120 PS).
'Honda HR-V Facelift (2019) und neuer Turbobenziner mit 182 PS'.
